name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: An interactive terminal on xterm.js 6, loaded lazily from the app's own bundle (no CDN), themed from the terminal.* roles of its region and rethemed when they change; keystrokes leave as bytes through onData, size changes through onResize, output goes in through ref.write.
usage: Use Terminal for an exec session or a shell: pass onData to the process's stdin (bytes, UTF-8), onResize to the process's terminal size, and write its stdout and stderr with ref.write(bytes) as they arrive (writes before xterm.js has loaded are queued). onReady fires once it is open. Set readOnly when the session ends (keystrokes are ignored, the cursor stops blinking) and ref.reset() before a new one. Mod+Shift+C copies the selection and Mod+Shift+V pastes; Ctrl+C goes to the process. ref.findNext and findPrevious search the scrollback. The height comes from className; the terminal fits its columns and rows to the element. Use LogViewer for output alone, CodeBlock for a fixed snippet.

props.name: ref
props.description: write(bytes | text), focus(), clear(), reset(), findNext(query), findPrevious(query), size().

props.name: onData
props.description: Keystrokes, pastes and terminal replies as bytes, for the process's stdin.

props.name: onResize
props.description: The size in cells once loaded and whenever the element's size changes.

props.name: onReady
props.description: Called once xterm.js has loaded and the terminal is open.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: The font size in px; text.code's size of the region by default.

props.name: scrollback
props.description: Lines kept above the screen (read at mount).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Output only: keystrokes are ignored and the cursor does not blink (a finished session).

props.name: screenReaderMode
props.description: xterm.js's screen reader mode: an accessible buffer of the output (read at mount).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the terminal and of its input.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own; set the height here.

slots.name: root
slots.description: role="group", the frame in terminal.bg; data-slot="terminal", data-loading until xterm.js has loaded, data-readonly.

slots.name: fallback
slots.description: "Loading the terminal…" (or why it could not load) until xterm.js is ready; data-slot="terminal-fallback".

slots.name: surface
slots.description: Where xterm.js renders, a data-foreign-dom element; data-slot="terminal-surface".

states.name: focus-within
states.description: The keyboard is in the terminal: the ring around the frame (ring.width in color.ring).

states.name: loading
states.description: xterm.js is loading: aria-busy, the progress cursor and the fallback text.

accessibility: The frame is role="group" with the accessible name, which xterm.js's input (a textarea) also takes; it is the tab stop, and every key, Tab and Escape included, goes to the process. Mod+Shift+C and Mod+Shift+V copy and paste.
screenReaderMode gives xterm.js's accessible buffer of the output (off by default: it costs speed); the app should also say when a session starts and ends outside the terminal.
Every ANSI colour reads at 4.5:1 on terminal.bg and the cursor at 3:1 (the token build checks each pair).
The frame shows the ring while the keyboard is inside: ring.width in color.ring.
